title: Seen
description: One paper in the feed (one JSON object per line in state/seen/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl, the month taken from added_at). Publish appends these; discover reads them, with state/queued/, to skip papers already judged.

id.description: Stable paper id: arxiv-<id> or doi-<doi with every character outside a-z 0-9 . _ - replaced by ->, lowercase.

chunk.description: Number of the chunk the item was added to.

added_at.description: UTC time the item entered the feed, RFC 3339. Same value as the feed item's added_at.
